messages:
jordan: Heads up — Lumos (third-party support) is asking for console/logs access to reproduce an error in tenant-prod for ~48h. They asked for project Viewer so they can navigate and tail logs. Any objections? logs may include user emails and IPs.
priya: Don’t grant broad Project Viewer. Viewer lets them see a lot of metadata. Can you get them to accept a narrow role or a view? Also need a signed NDA + ticket in ops before any access to prod logs containing PII. :warning:
jordan: Yep, opening ticket now (OPS-4121). The exact binding they proposed is:```bash
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding tenant-prod --member=serviceAccount:lumos-support@lumos.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/viewer
```
alex: For debugging we usually create an ephemeral service account with roles/logging.logViewer + roles/monitoring.viewer (if dashboards needed). Avoid roles/viewer. Also restrict with an IAM condition to the specific log name or label. Example condition:```
condition: title: "limited-log-view"
expression: "resource.name.startsWith('projects/tenant-prod/logs/app-')"
```
priya: If they need raw logs that contain PII, require DLP redaction or copy to a redaction sink before granting access. Alternatively provide a filtered Logs View (export or Logs Explorer saved view) and give them access to that. Both are auditable and lower blast radius.
jordan: If we do ephemeral SA, how do we rotate creds? Lumos wants console UI access to tail logs in real-time, not just exported views.
alex: We can create a short-lived OAuth client for the SA and enable Workload Identity / short-lived tokens, or create a temporary user in our IdP and add them to a group with only the log-viewer scoped role. But console UI may surface metadata outside the filtered log — prefer Logs Explorer saved view + exported sink to a restricted BigQuery dataset with redaction applied.
priya: Approval checklist: 1) OPS ticket + business justification, 2) signed Lumos NDA, 3) DLP sign-off if PII, 4) exact role + IAM condition or saved view, 5) expire access <= 24h (48h is heavy). If any raw PII access required then Security will do a risk call.
jordan: Understood — ops ticket OPS-4121 updated with NDA link and proposed ephemeral SA approach + condition. Requested 24h instead of 48h.
audit-bot: [automated] OPS-4121 created by jordan at 2024-06-11T15:22:00Z — tags: lumos, access-request.
priya: If you want, I can approve conditional log-viewer for 12-24h once NDA + ticket are in place. Please attach the exact condition expression and the redaction plan. :thumbsup:
jordan: Thanks — I'll attach condition and ask Lumos to confirm they accept the saved Logs Explorer view workflow. If they insist on console UI, we escalate to product/security for a risk exception and tighter monitoring.
alex: One more note — enable audit log forwarding for any ephemeral SA activity and add a Cloud Audit sink to ops-security for realtime alerting.
jordan: Will do. Marking this thread resolved for now — will post final access grant when OPS-4121 is approved. :white_check_mark:
